source_note: FY 2016/17 actuals from 2018-19 Budget Estimates Book p52 (Recurrent Revenue Budget by Ministry and Item). Pre-profit: Diamond Sales Tax 373.81M + Royalties 1.85M + Surface Rent 3.82M + misc licences 0.012M = 379.50M LSL. Equity: Dividends-Other 150.0M LSL (state stake in Letseng/Mothae). Total Ministry of Mining 529.50M LSL / 14.7 = 36.02M USD.

FY 2017/18 actuals from 2019-20 Budget Estimates Book p55. Pre-profit: Diamond Sales Tax 317.62M + Royalties 2.51M + Surface Rent 17.74M + 141000-Missing Description 58.58M + Diamond Dealers Licences 0.012M = 396.45M LSL. Equity: Dividends 60.0M LSL. Total 456.46M LSL / 13.3 = 34.32M USD.

FY 2018/19 actuals not in any of the provided books. Uses Approved Budget 2018/19 (from 2018-19 book p52 / 2019-20 book p55): Royalties 375.66M + Surface Rent 3.88M + Dividends 150.0M + Diamond Dealers Licences 7K + Sale of Maps 5K = 529.55M LSL / 13.2 = 40.12M USD. Splits approximated using 2016 ratio.

FY 2019/20 actuals from 2020-21 Budget Estimates Book p45. Pre-profit: Royalties 371.53M + Surface Rent 4.81M + Sale of Maps 4.9K = 376.35M LSL. Equity: Dividends 239.01M LSL (jumped due to strong Letseng performance). Diamond Sales Tax discontinued from FY 2019/20 onwards (rolled into Royalties). Total 615.36M LSL / 14.4 = 42.74M USD.

FY 2020/21 actuals from 2022-23 Budget Book p68. Pre-profit: Royalties 388.78M + Surface Rent 7.04M + Diamond Dealers Licences 17.5K + Sale of Maps 6.7K = 395.84M LSL. Equity: Dividends 120.0M LSL (lower vs 2019 due to COVID impact on diamond demand). Total 515.84M LSL / 16.4 = 31.45M USD.

FY 2021/22 actuals not available in provided books. Interpolated from FY 2020/21 actuals (515.84M) and FY 2022/23 actuals (556.08M) -> ~535.96M LSL / 14.8 = 36.21M USD. For reference, 2022-23 book p68 showed Approved Budget 2021/22 of only 207.42M (post-COVID conservative) but Revised Budget 643.65M. Splits interpolated.

FY 2022/23 actuals from 2024/25 Budget Book p58. Pre-profit: Royalties 428.45M + Surface Rent 4.92M + Diamond Dealers Licences 145.5K + Sale of Maps 3.0K = 433.52M LSL. Equity: Dividends 122.56M LSL. Total 556.08M LSL / 16.4 = 33.91M USD.
